question.text: Mr. Arjun Kapoor is an employee of the manager of a Cat II AIF scheme. What is the MINIMUM amount he must invest in that scheme under SEBI's employee/director concession?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations carve out a concessional minimum investment of INR 25 lakh for employees and directors of the manager of an AIF scheme, versus the INR 1 crore floor that applies to ordinary non-employee, non-accredited investors. Accredited Investors are governed separately under the AI framework, which gives flexibility on the minimum amount and does NOT equate to a fixed INR 25 lakh floor. The Trap: INR 50 lakh is a fabricated mid-point. INR 1 crore is the ordinary LP floor for non-employee, non-accredited investors. INR 2 crore is fabricated. Note: The stem and explanation were rewritten to reference the source-backed employee/director INR 25 lakh concession, since the workbook does not specify INR 25 lakh as the minimum for Accredited Investors. AI minimums follow the separate AI framework's flexibility, not the employee carve-out.
